breakpoints.note: The witness is admitted as a `SCALEBAR` block inside the map parser, so control enters `loadScalebar()` on the live `map->scalebar` object and the vulnerable embedded-label path becomes reachable.

First project parser statement that creates the vulnerability-relevant ownership state. Once the witness token stream reaches `LABEL` inside `SCALEBAR`, `loadScalebar()` parses directly into the embedded `scalebar->label` field, so later allocations and frees operate on an owner-managed object that `msFreeMap()` will revisit on error cleanup.

breakpoints.code: freeLabel(label);       /* free any structures allocated before EOF */
breakpoints.note: The patch removes this exact statement from the `EOF` arm, expressing the missing ownership obligation: `loadLabel()` must not free `scalebar->label` here because `msFreeMap()` is still responsible for that embedded object.
